hot_spots.reason: Missing sqrtPriceX96==0 check (KV-1/CP-003). View-only, Low severity. CLOB orders with only maxBound set could pass zero-price validation.
Transient slot DIRECT_SWAP_BEFORE_SWAP_AMOUNT_SLOT stale data when beforeSwap disabled but afterSwap enabled (KV-4/CP-001/HOOK-001). Known Low.

ruled_out_vectors.title: Pool type inflated amountOut bypasses Core reserves
confidence_deductions: conceptual test only, no integrated PoC
ruled_out_vectors.description: Pool type could return inflated amountOut. Core protects with _safeDecrementUint128 on reserve update (reverts if amountOut > reserve) and actualAmountIn <= originalAmountIn check.
ruled_out_vectors.impact: None — guarded by reserve decrement and input validation
ruled_out_vectors.proof_sketch: test_C1_pool_return_value_trust: if amountOut > reserve, _safeDecrementUint128 reverts. If actualAmountIn > originalAmountIn, check on line 1460 reverts.

ruled_out_vectors.title: Direct handler call bypasses hook validation
ruled_out_vectors.description: Handler's ammHandleTransfer checks msg.sender == AMM (immutable). No executeSwap function exists. Cannot bypass beforeSwap/afterSwap hooks by calling handler directly.
ruled_out_vectors.impact: None — handler validates AMM caller

ruled_out_vectors.title: Hook fee manipulation drains more than amountIn
ruled_out_vectors.description: Malicious hook could return inflated fee. Core checks totalFees > amountIn in _validateProtocolFees and reverts. Hook fee cannot exceed swap input amount.
ruled_out_vectors.impact: None — fee validation catches excess
ruled_out_vectors.proof_sketch: test_C3_hook_fee_exceeds_swap_amount + test_H3_hook_fee_manipulation_capped: _validateProtocolFees reverts when totalFees > amountIn.

ruled_out_vectors.title: Settings change between beforeSwap and afterSwap
ruled_out_vectors.description: Hook caches token settings at storage mapping level. Reentrancy guard prevents mid-swap registry updates. setTokenSettings is admin-only. Settings cannot change between beforeSwap and afterSwap.
ruled_out_vectors.impact: None — reentrancy guard + admin-only prevents mid-swap changes
ruled_out_vectors.proof_sketch: test_C4_settings_immutable_within_swap + test_H7_settings_cant_change_mid_swap: reentrancy guard blocks all paths.

ruled_out_vectors.title: Pool fee exceeds amountIn via pool type return
ruled_out_vectors.description: Pool type could return inflated fee. Core's _validateProtocolFees checks totalFees > amountIn and reverts LBAMM__FeeAmountExceedsInputAmount.
ruled_out_vectors.impact: None — fee validation in Core catches all excess fees

ruled_out_vectors.title: Handler to external reentrancy via token callbacks
ruled_out_vectors.description: Token transfer callbacks (ERC-777) could attempt reentrancy. Double protection: AMM transient ENTERED flag blocks AMM re-entry, handler's nonReentrant blocks handler re-entry.
ruled_out_vectors.impact: None — double reentrancy protection

ruled_out_vectors.title: Hook access control bypass via direct call
ruled_out_vectors.description: All state-changing hook functions check _requireCallerIsAMM(). AMM address is immutable. validateHandlerOrder is view-only exception (called by handlers for price checks).
ruled_out_vectors.impact: None — immutable AMM address check on all state-changing functions

ruled_out_vectors.title: Settlement conservation violation via handler
ruled_out_vectors.description: Core checks balanceInBefore + amountIn == balanceInAfter after handler execution. Handler cannot steal or short-change without causing revert.
ruled_out_vectors.impact: None — balance check enforces exact settlement

ruled_out_vectors.title: Hook fee overflow via combined beforeSwap + afterSwap fees
ruled_out_vectors.description: Max feeBPS is uint16 capped at 10000 (100%). Combined hook fees from beforeSwap + afterSwap caught by _validateProtocolFees: totalFees > amountIn → revert.
ruled_out_vectors.impact: None — fee cap + validation

ruled_out_vectors.title: Output exceeds reserves via pool type return
ruled_out_vectors.description: Pool type output bounded by reserves. _safeDecrementUint128 reverts if amountOut > reserve.
ruled_out_vectors.impact: None — safe decrement guard

ruled_out_vectors.title: Fee denomination mismatch across hook paths
confidence_deductions: code review only, no fuzz test
ruled_out_vectors.description: Fee denomination is consistent: tokenIn fees deducted from amountIn and transferred as tokenIn, tokenOut fees deducted from amountOut and transferred as tokenOut. Protocol fees always in tokenIn.
ruled_out_vectors.impact: None — denomination consistent across all paths

ruled_out_vectors.title: Sandwich attack bypasses limitAmount protection
ruled_out_vectors.description: SwapOrder.limitAmount provides minimum output floor. If sandwich attack pushes output below limitAmount, swap reverts.
ruled_out_vectors.impact: None — limitAmount protects against sandwich

ruled_out_vectors.title: Pool ID encoding edge cases with pool type address
ruled_out_vectors.description: Pool type address must fit in 112 bits (6 leading zero bytes). PoolDecoder.getPoolType extracts from bottom bits. Address > 2^112 would be truncated at pool creation.
ruled_out_vectors.impact: None — pool type address validated at creation

ruled_out_vectors.title: Diamond storage slot collision between facets
ruled_out_vectors.description: All facets use shared AppStorage at slot 0x9A1D via Storage.appStorage(). No module has own storage variables. Verified via Slither get_storage_layout: 0 slots for each module.
ruled_out_vectors.impact: None — single shared storage slot, no collision possible
ruled_out_vectors.proof_sketch: test_C15_storage_layout_no_collision + Slither get_storage_layout on all 4 modules.

ruled_out_vectors.title: Settings sync gap between registry and hook
ruled_out_vectors.description: setTokenSettings calls hooksToSync with original settings (not memSettings with initialized=true). Hook's registryUpdateTokenSettings receives settings without initialized flag. But hook re-fetches from registry if not initialized. Gas waste only, not exploitable.
ruled_out_vectors.impact: None — gas waste only (CP-005)

ruled_out_vectors.title: Transient storage stale data in direct swap path
confidence_deductions: Low severity confirmed by prior submissions
ruled_out_vectors.description: DIRECT_SWAP_BEFORE_SWAP_AMOUNT_SLOT written by beforeSwap, read by afterSwap. If beforeSwap flag disabled but afterSwap enabled, stale data from prior operation in same tx. Known HOOK-001. Low severity — only affects pricing bounds check in specific flag configuration.
ruled_out_vectors.impact: Low — stale pricing bounds check, no direct value extraction

ruled_out_vectors.title: validateHandlerOrder missing zero-price check
ruled_out_vectors.description: computeRatioX96 overflow returns 0. validateHandlerOrder does not check sqrtPriceX96==0 (unlike _validatePricingBounds). Zero price passes when only maxBound is set. View-only function called by CLOB handler for order validation. Known CP-003.
ruled_out_vectors.impact: Low — view function, CLOB order could be placed at invalid price but would fail at swap time via _validatePricingBounds
ruled_out_vectors.proof_sketch: test_KV1_* tests (4 tests covering overflow, zero check, bypass, and mitigation).

ruled_out_vectors.title: Handler token pair mismatch with pool
ruled_out_vectors.description: Core resolves token pair from poolId and passes to handler. Handler cannot override which tokens are used. Token pair is immutable in poolId encoding.
ruled_out_vectors.impact: None — Core dictates token pair

ruled_out_vectors.title: Pool ID collision between different pool types
ruled_out_vectors.description: Pool type address encoded in poolId. Different pool type addresses produce different poolIds even with same token pair and parameters.
ruled_out_vectors.impact: None — pool type in ID prevents collision

ruled_out_vectors.title: addLiquidity return value inflation
ruled_out_vectors.description: Pool type's addLiquidity returns (amount0Used, amount1Used). Core checks actual balance change matches expected. _safeIncrementUint128 catches overflow. Inflated returns would fail balance check.
ruled_out_vectors.impact: None — balance check + safe increment

ruled_out_vectors.title: Dust-loop extraction via repeated tiny swaps
ruled_out_vectors.description: Each swap pays fees with rounding favoring protocol (INV-SW03). 100 tiny swaps yield 0 profit — attacker loses at least 1 wei per swap in fees.
ruled_out_vectors.impact: None — rounding favors protocol

ruled_out_vectors.title: Permit feeOnTop unsigned field exploitation
ruled_out_vectors.description: feeOnTop is NOT signed in EIP-712 typehash (known design). But signer's limitAmount caps total exposure. Executor can set feeOnTop but cannot extract beyond signer's limit.
ruled_out_vectors.impact: None — limitAmount protects signer

theft_theses.thesis: Exploit pool type return value trust to inflate amountOut and drain reserves
theft_theses.reason: Core's _safeDecrementUint128 reverts if amountOut > reserve. Balance check at settlement catches any mismatch.

theft_theses.thesis: Bypass hook validation by calling handler directly
theft_theses.reason: Handler checks msg.sender == AMM (immutable). No alternative entry point exists.

theft_theses.thesis: Manipulate hook fees to extract more than amountIn
theft_theses.reason: _validateProtocolFees reverts when totalFees > amountIn. Fee cap is enforced at Core level.

theft_theses.thesis: Exploit transient storage stale data for profit
theft_theses.reason: Stale data affects pricing bounds check only (Low). No direct value extraction path. Would need beforeSwap disabled + afterSwap enabled (uncommon config).

theft_theses.thesis: Zero-price bypass in CLOB order validation for free tokens
theft_theses.reason: validateHandlerOrder is view-only. Even if CLOB order placed with zero price, swap execution goes through _validatePricingBounds which catches sqrtPriceX96==0.
